# About Lantern Supply Co.

Last updated: October 1, 2026
Owner: Priya Whitcomb-Nair

Lantern Supply Co. sells camping lanterns, oil lamps, fuel and parts from two showrooms in
Maryland and from the online store at lanternsupply.example. We make some of what we sell, we
repair everything we sell, and we have been doing both since 1987. This page is the short version
of who we are, for new employees and for customers who ask.

## Where we ship

Lantern Supply Co. ships to all 50 US states and to Canada. The company does not ship to any
other country, to US territories, or to APO/FPO addresses. Customers outside the United States
and Canada are referred to the authorized retailer list on the website.

The Firefly 100, our first LED lantern, was discontinued in 2018. No parts are stocked and the

## Welcome

Lantern Supply Co. was founded in 1987 by Marjorie and Dale Whitcomb in Frederick, Maryland, and
is still owned and run by the family. Priya Whitcomb-Nair, the founders' daughter, has been chief
executive since 2019. As of October 2026 there are 63 of us across the Frederick headquarters and
showroom, the Annapolis showroom and the Hagerstown warehouse and Repair Center. We are a small
company that sells a small range of things well. Most of the people who buy from us are repeat
customers, and most of them know a great deal about lanterns. Treat them that way.
